title: WHEN FACING A HARD CHOICE
LET HIS SPIRIT LEAD YOU
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step

quiet mountain lake early morning reflection

scenes.a: You stand silent before a hard choice today.
Your own understanding feels limited, and the noise around you brings no clarity.
Hear the word of the Lord. For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
scenes.sub: LED BY THE SPIRIT OF GOD

scenes.a: Lord, we quiet our anxious minds and yield our steps to You.
When we are uncertain which path to choose, let Your Holy Spirit guide our thoughts.
scenes.sub: ASKING HIS SPIRIT TO DIRECT YOU

scenes.a: Grant us humble wisdom to surrender our own plans and follow Your gentle direction.
Remind us that as Your children, we are never left to guess our way alone. Amen. You stand silent before a hard choice.
